_help: formula: the numbers behind the targets card. goals: calories added to (or removed from) maintenance.
adjust: every `everyDays` days the app compares the 7 day average weight with 2 weeks before.
Under `low` kg per week it suggests +step kcal, over `high` kg per week it suggests -step kcal.
foods: what I can log. Each food is ONE portion: `unit` says how big, kcal and protein are for that portion.
The values are approximate, from standard food tables. Change them if the label on your food says something else.
step: how much one tap adds (1 = a whole portion, 0.5 = half a portion).
mealPlans: one model day per kind of day. items point to foods by id, qty is the number of portions.
There are no prices in this file. I type what I spend in the app.
foodNote: Approximate values from standard food tables, for the portion written next to each food. Real portions change from day to day. This gives a clear picture, not an exact count.
portionGuide: Protein: one palm (meat, chicken, fish), or one bowl of lentils or beans.
Carbs: one plate of rice, pasta or couscous, or a piece of bread the size of a hand.
Fat: one tablespoon of oil, or one handful of nuts.
